label: GOD_4 wills a distinct recipient's esse to it, from the operative standard (inference)
rule: Extract the benefit requirement by testing its omission from an otherwise successful plan
meaning: Choose the operative standard for the same giver and effect. If benefit credit were optional, every requirement would remain satisfied after the edit. Rejection gives a required benefit clause for that effect in esse. The local recognition premise then applies to that clause and supplies recipient-directed willing.
